examples.text: pubbe sudaṃ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ utuniṃ'y'eva gacchanti, no anutuniṃ. eta'r'ahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ utunim'pi gacchanti, anutunim'pi gacchanti.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, idha khattiyakumāro brāhmaṇakaññāya saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappeyya, tesaṃ saṃvāsam'anvāya putto jāyetha, yo so khattiyakumārena brāhmaṇakaññāya putto uppanno, siyā so mātu'pi sadiso pitu'pi sadiso, khattiyo'ti'pi vattabbo brāhmaṇo'ti'pi vattabbo'ti?

78313.meaning1: name of an ascetic; Asita Devala; previous incarnation of the Buddha
78313.commentary: (MNa) asito'ti kāḷako. devalo'ti tassa nāmaṃ, ayam'eva bhagavā tena samayena.

examples.text: atha kho, assalāyana, asito devalo isi kesamassuṃ kappetvā mañjiṭṭhavaṇṇāni dussāni nivāsetvā paṭaliyo upāhanā āruhitvā jātarūpamayaṃ daṇḍaṃ gahetvā sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ patthaṇḍile pāturahosi.
te tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpesuṃ, tiṇhāni satthāni kārāpetvā gāmaghātam'pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, nigamaghātam'pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, nagaraghātam'pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ, panthaduhanam'pi upakkamiṃsu kātuṃ.
jānanti pana bhonto, yā janimātā brāhmaṇaṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇan'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.

78316.commentary: (MNt) khemiyā nāma rañño deviyā ropitattā taṃ ambavanaṃ khemiy'ambavanan'ti vuccatī'ti vadanti.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā udeno bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati khemiy'ambavane. tena kho pana samayena ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo bārāṇasiṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

addhā m'esā, bho udena, sānuggahā vācā bhāsitā. atthi dhammiko paribbajo, evaṃ me ettha hoti.

78329.commentary: (MNa) n'ālam'etthā'ti, bhāradvāja, saccaṃ anurakkhissāmī'ti paṭipannena viññunā yaṃ mayā gahitaṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti ettha ek'aṃsen'eva niṭṭhaṃ gantuṃ n'ālaṃ na yuttan'ti upari pucchāya maggaṃ vivaritvā ṭhapesi.

kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, sacca-anurakkhaṇā hoti, kittāvatā saccam'anurakkhati? sacca-anurakkhaṇaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā'ti.
ettāvatā, bho gotama, sacc'ānurakkhaṇā hoti, ettāvatā saccam'anurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ sacc'ānurakkhaṇaṃ pekkhāma. kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, sacc'ānubodho hoti, kittāvatā saccam'anubujjhati?
evaṃ, gahapatī'ti. tena hi, bhante, muhuttaṃ āgamehi yāv'assa atthaṃ pekkhāmī'ti.

tatth'āyaṃ samayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.

78336.commentary: (MNa) gopo vā'ti yathā gopako attanā rakkhitabbaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ thenento akiccakārī hoti, evan'ti attho. iminā nayena sabbavāresu attho veditabbo.

78344.meaning1: came to ask; arrived to question
78344.commentary: (NIDD2) bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamā'ti buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhuṃ pucchituṃ yācituṃ ajjhesituṃ pasādetuṃ āgamhā āgatamhā upāgat'amhā sampatt'amhā, tayā saddhiṃ samāgatamhā'ti, bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamā. (SNPa) bhavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgammā'ti mayañ'hi bhavantaṃ pucchissāmā'ti tato tato cakkavāḷā āgatā'ti attho. etena ādaraṃ dasseti.

examples.text: te na sakkoma ñāpetuṃ, aññam'aññaṃ mayaṃ ubho, bhavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamā, sambuddhaṃ iti vissutaṃ.

78345.commentary: (MNa) tiṇarukkhe'ti ettha antopheggū bahisārā antamaso tālanāḷiker'ādayo'pi tiṇān'eva, antosārā pana bahipheggū sabbe rukkhā nāma.

examples.text: tiṇarukkhe'pi jānātha, na c'āpi paṭijānare, liṅgaṃ jātimayaṃ tesaṃ, aññam'aññā hi jātiyo.

78346.meaning1: possesses self-awareness; knows one's own existence
78346.commentary: (MNa) na c'āpi paṭijānare'ti mayaṃ tiṇā mayaṃ rukkhā'ti vā, ahaṃ tiṇaṃ, ahaṃ rukkho'ti vā evaṃ na jānanti.

examples.text: tiṇarukkhe'pi jānātha, na c'āpi paṭijānare, liṅgaṃ jātimayaṃ tesaṃ, aññam'aññā hi jātiyo.
na gīvāya na aṃsehi, na udarena na piṭṭhiyā, na soṇiyā na urasā, na sambādhe na methune.

78348.commentary: (MNa) vokāran'ti nānattaṃ. ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhep'attho, yathā hi tiracchānānaṃ yonisiddham'eva kes'ādisaṇṭhānena nānattaṃ, tathā brāhmaṇ'ādīnaṃ attano attano sarīre taṃ n'atthi. evaṃ sante'pi yadetaṃ brāhmaṇo khattiyo'ti vokāraṃ, taṃ vokārañ'ca manussesu samaññāya pavuccati, vohāramatten'eva pavuccatī'ti.

examples.text: paccattañ'ca sarīresu, manussesv'etaṃ na vijjati, vokārañ'ca manussesu, samaññāya pavuccati.

78349.meaning1: absolutive suffix denoting a concurrent or completed action
78349.commentary: (ANa) ubho'nte viditvānā'ti dve ante dve koṭṭhāse jānitvā.

examples.text: yo ubho'nte viditvāna, majjhe mantā na lippati, taṃ brūmi mahāpuriso'ti, so'dha sibbinim'accagā'ti.

78350.meaning1: not without; not devoid (of); (comm) not empty

examples.text: kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, seyyath'idaṃ, hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathā'ti dasamena saddena.

atha kho subho māṇavo todeyyaputto yassa gahapatissa nivesane paṭivasati taṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca, sutaṃ m'etaṃ, gahapati, avivittā sāvatthī arahantehī'ti. kaṃ nu khvajja samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā payirupāseyyāmāti?

78351.commentary: (NIDD1) yehī'ti yehi diṭṭhigatehi. vivitto'ti kāyaduccaritena ritto vivitto pavivitto, vacīduccaritena… manoduccaritena… rāgena… sabb'ākusal'ābhisaṅkhārehi ritto vivitto pavivitto.

examples.text: katamāni tīṇi? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā ca hoti, dussīlyañ'c'assa pahīnaṃ hoti, tena ca vivitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhiko ca hoti, micchādiṭṭhi c'assa pahīnā hoti, tāya ca vivitto hoti, khīṇ'āsavo ca hoti, āsavā c'assa pahīnā honti, tehi ca vivitto hoti.
yehi vivitto vicareyya loke, na tāni uggayha vadeyya nāgo, jal'ambujaṃ kaṇḍakaṃ vārijaṃ yathā, jalena paṅkena c'anūpalittaṃ, evaṃ munī santivādo agiddho, kāme ca loke ca anūpalitto.

78352.meaning1: in this case I; in this situation I

78378.commentary: (MNa) paṇ'opaṇaviyā'ti paṇaviyā ca opaṇaviyā ca. na upetī'ti na hoti. kayavikkayakāle viya agghavaḍḍhanahāpanaṃ na hotī'ti attho. ayaṃ goṇo kiṃ agghati, vīsati agghatī'ti bhaṇanto paṇati nāma. na vīsati agghati, dasa agghatī'ti bhaṇanto opaṇati nāma. idaṃ paṭisedhento āha paṇ'opaṇaviyā na upetī'ti. idāni taṃ paṇ'opaṇaviyaṃ dassetuṃ evañ'ca no assa, atha naṃ kareyyāma, na ca no evam'assa, na naṃ kareyyāmā'ti āha.
